scope: Restore the Tahoe launcher Favorites category and enable real-time wallpaper sampling by default for bundled desktop glass widgets.
approval: The maintainer approved the paired release after reviewing the live glass preview and the Tahoe Favorites preview, and asked to leave README files untouched.

checks.command: Four isolated native launcher cases passed on Tahoe with both presets in light and dark. Favorites opens the full saved list and toggles back to All Apps.
Five isolated desktop-widget packaging and installer checks passed. The bundled archive comparison found exactly 14 realtimeRefraction default changes.

KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland: installed the shared candidate and captured Tahoe Favorites. The bundled calendar, analog clock and timer updated their rendered wallpaper samples through light, dark and light in the same Plasma session.
Verified installed configuration and launcher SHA-256 values against the release sources and regenerated the component fingerprints.
Verified the published Tahoe version, immutable pin and archive SHA-256.

coverage_limits: KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland with one display. Golden Gate uses the same desktop widget package. The launcher change is scoped to Tahoe style.
